original_query: Create a pivot table to summarize the average percentage of the population affected by a certain deprivation factor (Column D) for each Unitary Authority (Column A).
optimized_code:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('table_name.csv')
pivot_table = df.pivot_table(
    values='Indices of Deprivation 2015 - South East U.A.s (n.b. Rank 1 = most deprived).3', 
    index='Indices of Deprivation 2015 - South East U.A.s (n.b. Rank 1 = most deprived)', 
    aggfunc='mean'
).reset_index()

# Rename columns for better readability
pivot_table.columns = ['Unitary Authority', 'Average Deprivation Percentage']

pivot_table.to_csv('output.csv', index=False)
